external_entities.name: Customers
external_entities.description: People who browse and order socks through the mobile app and receive faxed confirmations.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: Mobile application used by customers to browse and order socks.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: web API
processes.description: API used by the mobile app; it stores customer information and hands orders to SIMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Authentication is unspecified: "Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication".

processes.name: stock and inventory system
processes.description: SIMS, the stock and inventory system, receives orders from the web API, writes delivery addresses to a flat file, and sends dispatch notes to the fax gateway.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS, our stock and inventory system
processes.notes: The source says SIMS has been running since long before the app existed.

processes.name: fax gateway
processes.description: Gateway that receives dispatch notes, dials the number stored against the order, and faxes confirmations to customers.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway
processes.notes: Nobody checks whether the fax arrived at the right place.

processes.name: macros
processes.description: Spreadsheet macros that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API
processes.notes: The macros are described as a stopgap that is still in use.

data_stores.name: user database
data_stores.description: Database containing customer names, addresses, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with
data_stores.notes: The source does not state whether the user database is encrypted.

data_stores.name: flat file
data_stores.description: File kept alongside SIMS containing delivery addresses only.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: The source does not state whether the flat file is encrypted.

data_stores.name: spreadsheet
data_stores.description: Spreadsheet containing the marketing catalogue; it is stored on a marketing laptop in the office.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet
data_stores.notes: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customers browse and place sock orders through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: API requests
data_flows.description: The mobile app communicates with the web API over HTTP.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS

data_flows.name: customer records
data_flows.description: The web API keeps customer information in the user database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
data_flows.data_description: Customer name, address, and payment card information

data_flows.name: orders
data_flows.description: When an order is placed, the web API hands the order to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: delivery address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway
data_flows.data_description: Dispatch note containing customer confirmation information

data_flows.name: confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes customers a confirmation containing their name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order, and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.
data_flows.data_description: Customer confirmation with name and address

data_flows.name: catalogue changes
data_flows.description: Spreadsheet macros send SQL statements directly to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: Sokify
trust_boundaries.description: General Sokify system environment containing the mobile app, web API, SIMS, fax gateway, and associated data stores.

trust_boundaries.name: office
trust_boundaries.description: Office environment where the marketing laptop and spreadsheet are located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office

assumptions.assumption: The web API is internet-facing because Sokify sells socks online through a mobile app that communicates with the API.
assumptions.basis: The description says Sokify sells socks online and that the mobile app talks to the web API.

assumptions.assumption: The user database is confidential because it contains customer names, addresses, and payment-card information.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents are personal and payment information.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file is confidential because it contains customer delivery addresses.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents are customer addresses.
